Narrative: Worker fell 3 meters from scaffolding while attempting to secure a loose pipe. Safety harness was not properly engaged.
A minor leak was detected in the secondary cooling pump. The system was temporarily shut down and repaired. No injuries.
Forklift carrying a heavy load tipped over while making a sharp turn. Operator was trapped and suffered a compound fracture.
Technician noticed exposed high-voltage wiring near a puddle of water before starting work. Area was immediately secured and isolated. A potentially lethal shock was avoided.
Employee slipped on a wet surface in the hallway. Suffered a minor sprain to the wrist. Treated with first aid.
A valve failed resulting in the release of 50 gallons of corrosive solvent. Two workers inhaled fumes and required medical observation.
Employee reported lower back pain after prolonged periods of lifting archive boxes. Advised rest.
A poorly stacked pallet collapsed, striking a worker on the shoulder. Worker suffered severe bruising but no broken bones.
A sudden pressure buildup caused a localized explosion in Unit 3. Multiple personnel were injured and required emergency evacuation.
While operating a band saw, an operator sustained a deep cut to the left hand. Required stitches but did not involve tendon damage.
